title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-29 09:37:28 最新章节：第447章 滚远点
slug: 寡村寡事第446章后山的驴
content_zh:
初秋，落叶渐黄。
芙蓉村，村口的玉米地一片金黄，玉米叶儿落下摊在地上，像铺上一层金毯子。
柳大春后院的茅房里，师娘杨桃花正在小解，初秋的冷风透过后墙，直顶着师娘吹，都冻得她发红。
这茅房年久未修，一侧的木梁岌岌可危，背后的石墙早已经塌了。
“傻徒儿，茅房没草纸了，你帮师娘拿纸来。”师娘杨桃花正要起身时才发现茅房早已没了厕纸。
后厨傻子柳大春探出个脑袋来，呵呵笑着，回应道：“师娘，你用树枝吧，家里没纸了。”
“你个傻徒儿，树枝怎么行呢，算了算了。”师娘杨桃花说着就准备起身。
杨桃花刚站了起来，转头看了一眼，一双眼睛正直溜溜地看着自己。
“啊！！赵大发！你！”
杨桃花的脸一下子就红了，刚才这个老光棍一直在后面偷看自己，真是个王八蛋。
赵大发却是面红耳赤，直接从茅房后面跳了过去。
一把将杨桃花给扑倒在了地上，像一头凶猛的野兽。
这赵大发是村里出了名的色胚子，又是个老光棍，平日子正事不干，专门在村里溜达，寻找寡妇，留守妇女下手。
这个赵大发胆子肥，人恶，没少欺负女人。
今个儿溜达至此，正好撞见寡妇杨桃花在茅房，便激发兽性。
“赵大发，你个混蛋，放开我！”杨桃花挣扎着，却怎么也推不动这个色胚子，甚是绝望。
“杨桃花，你个娘们就别装了，这三四十的女人如狼似虎，死了老公，那个傻子又屁不懂，我还不知道你不想男人？呵呵。”赵大发看着眼前漂亮的尤物，瞪的眼睛发亮。
这杨桃花四十来岁的年纪，正风韵犹存，浑身都散发着熟透的女人味。
这种极品熟女，正是老男人恋恋不忘的品种。
杨桃花一见，羞地面红耳赤，抓起旁边的石头朝赵大发的脑袋砸去。

这一砸，正中。
赵大发的脑袋流出血来。
赵大发用手摸了摸，看了看血，整个人都凶狠恶煞起来，骂道：“你个臭婊子！”
说着，赵大发直接给了杨桃花两巴掌。
顿时，杨桃花的嘴巴被打出了血。
就在这时。
傻子柳大春不知道从哪里冒了出来，大喊着：“放开我师娘，不许欺负我师娘。”
赵大发回头看了一眼，哈哈大笑起来：“哈哈，这不是傻大春吗？你要过来，我就宰了你！”
傻子柳大春眼里只知道师娘被欺负了，像一头蛮牛样冲了过去。
content_en:
In early autumn, the fallen leaves gradually turn yellow.
In Furong Village, the cornfield at the entrance of the village is golden, and the corn leaves have fallen and spread on the ground, like a golden blanket.
In the hut in Liu Dachun's backyard, his wife Yang Taohua was urinating. The cold wind of early autumn passed through the back wall and blew directly against her, making her turn red from the cold.
This hut has not been repaired for a long time, the wooden beams on one side are in danger, and the stone wall behind has collapsed.
"Silly disciple, there is no toilet paper in the latrine. Please help the master's wife get paper." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, was about to get up when she realized that there was no toilet paper in the latrine.
Liu Dachun, the fool in the kitchen, stuck his head out, chuckled, and responded: "Master's wife, you can use branches, there is no paper at home."
"You stupid disciple, what's wrong with the branches? Forget it." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said as she prepared to stand up.
Yang Taohua just stood up, turned around and took a look, a pair of eyes looking directly at herself.
"Ah!! Zhao Dafa! You!"
Yang Taohua's face suddenly turned red. This old bachelor had been peeking at her from behind. He was really a bastard.
Zhao Dafa, however, blushed and jumped directly from behind the hut.
He threw Carambola to the ground like a ferocious beast.
This Zhao Dafa was a well-known pervert in the village, and he was also an old bachelor. He did not do any serious work on weekdays, but wandered around the village looking for widows and left-behind women to attack.
This Zhao Dafa is bold, fat, evil, and often bullies women.
I was walking here today and happened to see the widow's carambola flower in the hut, which aroused my animal nature.
"Zhao Dafa, you bastard, let me go!" Yang Taohua struggled, but she couldn't push this pervert, she was very desperate.
"Yang Taohua, you bitch, stop pretending. These women in their thirties and forties are like wolves and tigers. Their husbands are dead. That fool doesn't understand. I don't know that you don't want a man? Haha." Zhao Dafa stared at the beautiful woman in front of him, his eyes bright.
This Yang Taohua is in her forties, but her charm is still there, and her whole body exudes a mature femininity.
This kind of top-notch mature woman is exactly the type that old men will never forget.
When Yang Taohua saw it, her face turned red with embarrassment, she grabbed the stone next to her and threw it at Zhao Dafa's head.
This hit hit the spot.
Zhao Dafa's head was bleeding.
Zhao Dafa touched it with his hand and looked at the blood. His whole body became fierce and he cursed: "You stinking bitch!"
Saying that, Zhao Dafa slapped Yang Taohua twice.
Suddenly, Yang Taohua’s mouth was bleeding.
Just then.
The idiot Liu Dachun appeared out of nowhere and shouted: "Let go of my wife, don't bully my wife."
Zhao Dafa looked back and laughed loudly: "Haha, isn't this silly Dachun? If you come over, I will kill you!"
The fool Liu Dachun only knew in his eyes that the master's wife was being bullied, and rushed over like a wild bull.
